name: open_schematic_viewer
description: Launch the live schematic viewer. The viewer shows the schematic as SVG and auto-refreshes when the file changes. Use this after placing components so the user can see the schematic in real-time as you edit it. For hierarchical designs, pass the root schematic — the viewer discovers every sheet reachable from it and shows a sheet selector.

schematic.description: Path to the root .kicad_sch file to view
